purpose: Teach: 難病/治ら/力不足/カオス/始まら/危うい/宛先/叶わ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、難病研究の倫理、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on rare-disease ethics was really thoughtfully done.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Steady gaze, unhurried pace. Clear professional respect without performance. The voice of someone who genuinely reads student work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。治らないケースへの心理ケア、章を割きました。
lines.en: Yes. I dedicated a whole chapter to psychological care for untreatable cases.
lines.style: Careful and precise. Slight lift on the opening — pride tempered by awareness of how young this voice is. Measured, grounded. Not defensive, just wanting to be understood clearly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 力不足を感じる研究者、多いとか。
lines.en: A lot of researchers feel that inadequacy, I think.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Slight pause before speaking, like she's turning something over. Gentle observation — not lecturing, witnessing something true about the field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術界全体がカオスに陥る瞬間も、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I addressed those moments when the whole academic system kind of breaks down.
lines.style: Quieter now, more vulnerable. Careful not to overstate. Aware he's touching on something big. Small breath before the last phrase, like he's steadying himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 治験開始がまだ始まらない案件、批判の対象ですね。
lines.en: Trials that haven't even started yet — those become the real target of criticism.
lines.style: Observant, slightly troubled undertone. Speaking from what she's seen, not from theory. Slow, deliberate. The weight of understanding institutional failure without anger.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 倫理委員会、危うい判断、避けるべきです。
lines.en: Ethics committees have to avoid making those risky calls. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firmer conviction. The first time real conviction enters his voice — not defensive, but grounded. Direct but not harsh. This matters to him and it shows in the clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文の宛先、医療誌、適切に選びましたね。
lines.en: You chose the right journals for this. Very appropriate placements.
lines.style: Warm close. A teacher stepping back to let a student see what they've accomplished. Quiet satisfaction. The voice that says: you did good work and you know where it belongs now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療法、まだ叶わぬ夢ですが、進んでいきます。
lines.en: A cure still feels impossible right now, but — the work moves forward.
lines.style: Soft, almost private. Slight breathiness, like he's been holding something. Not hopeful in a loud way — hopeful the way someone keeps working anyway. Trailing off gently, looking past the moment.
